name: smwmusic-chrono-trigger-secret-of-the-forest
title: Chrono Trigger - Secret of the Forest
description:
The iconic forest theme from Chrono Trigger. Suitable for exploratory areas.

Comes with 2 versions, one that uses a liberal amount of pitch-modulated instruments to sound closer to the original, and one which uses none to preserve that raw, unfiltered, SMW sound. Take your pick.
